title: Meet the Premises Standards for public transport buildings
what: Building certifiers, developers and managers must ensure public transport buildings meet the Access Code's performance requirements by the target dates.

sources.title: Disability (Access to Premises — Buildings) Standards 2010
sources.quote: (3) The building certifier, building developer or building manager must ensure that the public transport service meets the performance requirements of the Access Code that apply to it for each aspect of the public transport building mentioned in an item of the following table, on and after the target date mentioned in the item, to at least the level of compliance mentioned in the item.

sources.title: Disability Discrimination Act 1992
sources.quote: Commission means the Australian Human Rights Commission.

sources.title: Administrative Arrangements Order
sources.locator: Part 2 (Attorney-General's Department), legislation administered by the Minister (compilation C2025Q00005 from 2025-07-01)

reach.condition: if it certifies, develops or manages a public transport building
